nodes.description: Owned.owner: current contract owner address, set to msg.sender in constructor and updated in acceptOwnership
Owned.newOwner: pending owner set by transferOwnership and consumed/reset by acceptOwnership
Owned.transferOwnership(address _newOwner) onlyOwner: stages a new owner without transferring control
Owned.acceptOwnership(): requires msg.sender == newOwner, moves owner to newOwner and zeroes newOwner
Owned constructor: assigns owner = msg.sender at deployment
Admined.admins: mapping(address => bool) of privileged admin accounts
Admined.isAdmin(address addr) public returns (bool): true if addr is a stored admin or the owner; used by onlyAdmin
Admined.addAdmin(address addr) onlyOwner: adds an admin, rejecting duplicates and the owner
Admined.removeAdmin(address addr) onlyOwner: deletes an existing admin

MetadataDeveryERC721Wrapper.token: admin-settable address used as the delegatecall target in transfer/approve functions (critical: attacker/compromised admin controls code that runs in this contract's storage context)
MetadataDeveryERC721Wrapper.tokenContract: IERC721 interface pointer to the wrapped NFT, only used for view queries
MetadataDeveryERC721Wrapper._tokenURIs: mapping(uint256 => string) of token metadata, written by setTokenURI and read by tokenURI
setERC721(address _token) onlyAdmin: stores the wrapped token address and IERC721 pointer; sets the delegatecall target without validating it is a contract or trusted implementation

ownerOf(uint256 tokenId): read-only ERC721 owner query forwarded to tokenContract; also used by setTokenURI for authorization

approve(address,uint256): performs an unchecked delegatecall into token
getApproved(uint256): read-only approval query forwarded to tokenContract
setApprovalForAll(address,bool): performs an unchecked delegatecall into token, granting operator rights in this contract's storage context

supportsInterface(bytes4): unconditionally returns true, falsely advertising every ERC165 interface
